caption:
3 pay-later plans and you still don't know what you owe 🪺

it starts small. 1 plan for the new phone, 1 for the concert tickets, and 1 for something you honestly can't remember buying. each app shows its own due date. your bank app shows a balance that has no idea any of the 3 exist.

so the real number lives nowhere. you find it out in pieces, on the 5th, the 12th and the 20th of every month.

that's why we built Nestly. banks, e-wallets, pay-later plans, loans and bills sit on 1 screen in Nestly. set a savings goal and it rounds up your spare change. snap a receipt and it gets sorted. then ask the AI planner what you can afford, before you tap "pay later" a 4th time.

it's in beta at nestly.harnova.my. email sign-up, PIN lock. nothing fancy.

share this with the friend who has 3 pay-later apps 👇
